who.value: Live buyer with no payment method saved

job.value: bid on the current lot without setting up a wallet first

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The live lot 'Charizard SAR 223/197' with 'rockstar_shark5597 is winning', 'S$12' and the timer reads as a live auction.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The orange 'Bid: S$13 ›' button is the most noticeable element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Bid: S$13' and 'Custom' say what each does.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Live terms ('Lot #1', 'is winning') are familiar to a bidder.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The buyer can bid now, but nothing on the first screen tells them about the S$20 cap that applies because no wallet is set up.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Wallet and cap detail are left for later states rather than shown up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: All elements belong to bidding in a show.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Bid button and price carry the action with no prose.
